pages.title: Ritual Brazier
pages.text: A ritual vessel used in $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/celestial_infusion)Celestial Infusion$(/l) and $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual)Nature's Ritual$(/l). To create one, crouch and right-click any plank block with an $(l:hexalia:content/tools#athame)Athame$(/l).

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: For Nature's Ritual, place an offering in each needed brazier, then add Salt. Braziers may stand anywhere on the Ritual Table's level within 8 blocks; no fixed pattern is required. Only matched braziers are consumed. Celestial Infusion instead uses one unsalted brazier beneath open sky.
